messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] destrand option
parts:
Hi,
when destrand is TRUE,  the Cs on each strand of a CpG  are merged and makes a one set of methylated and unmethylated counts instead of two sets. I don't know what you are seeing in IGV but I if the counts don't add up it may be because of a coverage threshold we apply when reading the files from SAM format.

Best,
Altuna


On Thu, Apr 24, 2014 at 10:29 PM, ssm <gilg...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hello,

I am trying to use methylkit for rrbs data. I used the destrand = TRUE (I am looking at CpGs).
I am looking at the results (the coverage, num Cs and Num Ts) together with viewing in IGV. I do not understand the rules on how you count the Cs and Gs for each position. It seems to me that sometime both C and G coordinates are counted together and sometime not (even in the same coordinate for different samples). The number of methylated/unmethylated bases I see in IGV does not fit the numbers I get.
Can you help with this please? I am new to rrbs so sorry if this is trivial.

Thanks a lot
